themes_detail.label: Illegal Posting Explosion
themes_detail.summary: Illegal posting complaints surged to 6 this week versus 0.1 per week average over the prior 8 weeks—a 4700% spike (z-score: 17.76)—suggesting a sudden, coordinated campaign or enforcement gap in Bed-Stuy this week.
evidence: 6 illegal posting complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.1 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (4700% increase)
Z-score of 17.76 indicates extreme statistical anomaly
Spike is brand-new—no signal in prior weeks
reporting_angles: Map the geographic concentration of illegal postings—are they clustered around specific subway stations, commercial corridors, or residential blocks?
Interview Sanitation Dept. about whether this reflects a known problem (gang tags, political campaigns, real estate ads) or a sudden enforcement lapse

themes_detail.label: Encampment Crisis Accelerating
themes_detail.summary: Encampment complaints jumped to 33 this week versus 2.1 per week average over 8 weeks—a 1453% spike (z-score: 14.79)—indicating a sharp surge in visible homelessness or camp density in Bed-Stuy this week.
evidence: 33 encampment complaints THIS WEEK vs. 2.1 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (1453% increase)
Z-score of 14.79 indicates extreme statistical anomaly
Community Board has standing request for 'services for the homeless' (unfunded/unresolved year-over-year)
Timing coincides with warming weather or possible sweep from adjacent district
reporting_angles: Ground-truth the complaints: visit reported locations to assess scale and conditions; interview residents and business owners about safety/sanitation concerns
Investigate timing—did DHS close a shelter, end cold-weather protocols, or conduct sweeps in nearby areas pushing people into Bed-Stuy?
Profile a resident or advocate: how is this affecting day-to-day life in specific blocks?

themes_detail.label: Park Violations & Animal Control Surge
themes_detail.summary: Park rule violations and unleashed dog complaints spike in the last 2 weeks (3 violations 2 weeks ago vs. 0.1 avg; 6 unleashed dogs 2 weeks ago vs. 1.4 avg)—suggesting either degraded park conditions or a specific incident triggering multiple complaints.
evidence: Violation of Park Rules: 3 complaints 2 weeks ago vs. 0.1 weekly average (2300% increase, z-score: 8.69)
Unleashed Dog: 6 complaints 2 weeks ago vs. 1.4 weekly average (336% increase, z-score: 3.28)
Animal in a Park: 17 complaints last week vs. 3.1 weekly average (444% increase, z-score: 5.86)
Community Board has standing request for expanded parks/playground amenities
reporting_angles: Identify the parks with the most complaints—is one park (e.g., Prospect Heights, Marcus Garvey) the focal point?
Interview Parks Dept. and community: are there specific rule violations (alcohol, off-leash zones, unsafe animal behavior) or is this tied to increased usage?
Assess whether the community board's unfunded park expansion request is now urgent given these safety signals

themes_detail.label: Elevator Outages Spike
themes_detail.summary: Elevator complaints rose to 15 last week versus 5.9 per week average over 8 weeks—a 155% spike (z-score: 4.5)—affecting access in a district with significant multi-family housing.
evidence: 15 elevator complaints last week vs. 5.9 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (155% increase, z-score: 4.5)
Spike follows weeks of elevated maintenance/facility complaints (30 two weeks ago vs. 8.6 avg, +248%)
DOB filings show 487 alteration permits filed in last 90 days, suggesting ongoing construction that may impact building systems
reporting_angles: Interview residents, especially elderly and disabled tenants, about how elevator outages affect them (ability to work, access medical care)
Cross-check with DOB and HPD: are these complaints tied to buildings under renovation or poor landlord maintenance?
Contact HPD to assess enforcement action against repeat offenders

themes_detail.label: Construction & Plumbing Strain
themes_detail.summary: General construction and plumbing complaints rose to 27 last week versus 16.8 per week average—a 61% increase (z-score: 3.43)—consistent with 838 DOB permits filed in 90 days and reflecting broader building disturbance.
evidence: 27 general construction/plumbing complaints last week vs. 16.8 weekly average (61% increase, z-score: 3.43)
838 DOB building permits filed in last 90 days (487 alterations, 144 new buildings, 100 ALT-CO filings)
Long-running baseline: 678 plumbing complaints over 90 days (third most common issue)
Related spike in elevator complaints suggests building system stress
reporting_angles: Map active DOB permits—are spikes in construction complaints concentrated in specific neighborhoods within Bed-Stuy?
Interview residents about quality-of-life impacts (noise, dust, water shutoffs, vibration) in heavily permitted blocks
Assess whether permit compliance and community notification is adequate
